config.no_mappings: No activity mappings configured yet. Start with `/activity-role add`.
config.title: 🎮 Activity Role Settings

err.bad_app_id: ⚠️ An application ID must be digits only.
err.empty_name: ⚠️ The activity name cannot be blank.
err.entry_not_found: ⚠️ That entry no longer exists; it may already have been removed.
err.log_channel_perms: ⚠️ The bot cannot view or send messages in {channel}. Fix that first, then set it again.
err.missing_manage_roles: ⚠️ The bot is missing the Manage Roles permission, so activity roles cannot be enabled.
err.no_match: ⚠️ Nothing in the game list matches "{query}".
err.pattern_too_short: ⚠️ A contains-match needs at least 3 characters; anything shorter matches far too many activities.
err.refresh_cooldown: ⚠️ The game list is shared globally and was just refreshed. Try again after {when}.
err.refresh_failed: ⚠️ Could not refresh the game list. Please try again later.
err.role_everyone: ⚠️ @everyone cannot be used as an activity role.
err.role_managed: ⚠️ {role} is managed by an integration, so the bot cannot assign it.
err.role_too_high: ⚠️ {role} is at or above the bot's highest role, so it cannot be assigned.
err.types_empty: ⚠️ At least one activity type must remain enabled.

msg.added_custom_unverified:
✅ Mapped `{app_id}` to {role}.
⚠️ That ID could not be resolved to a name, so double-check it for typos — matching itself still works.
msg.added_pattern: ✅ {role} will now be granted when an activity name contains "{pattern}".
msg.mode_set_live: ✅ Mode set to **live**: the role is removed once the activity stops.
msg.mode_set_sticky: ✅ Mode set to **sticky**: the role is kept once earned.

observed.footer: Anything a member runs here shows up, even apps missing from Discord's game list.
observed.title: 🔍 Activities Recently Seen Here

warn.no_presence_intent: This bot does not currently have the Presence intent, so no roles will change. Your configuration is kept and takes effect as soon as the intent is enabled.
warn.raw_disabled: `on_raw_presence_update` is disabled (it defaults off while the members intent is on). Pass `enable_raw_presences=True` to the Bot constructor, or only already-cached members will be updated.
